units.source_text: 当千重子发现紫花地丁开花时，在院子里低低飞舞的成群小白蝴蝶，从枫树干飞到了紫花地丁附近。

en.t: When Chieko noticed that the violets had bloomed, swarms of little white butterflies fluttering low in the garden flew from the maple trunk to the violets nearby.

units.source_text: 枫树正抽出微红的小嫩芽，蝶群在那上面翩翩飘舞，白色点点，衬得实在美极了。

en.t: The maple was just putting out tiny reddish young buds, and the butterflies fluttered lightly above them, their white specks setting off the scene with extraordinary beauty.

units.source_text: 两株紫花地丁的叶子和花朵，都在枫树树干新长的青苔上，投下了隐隐的影子。

en.t: The leaves and flowers of the two violet plants cast faint shadows on the new green moss growing on the maple trunk.
